layer.plainEnglish: In plain English, The modifier layer means: Enhanced Input resolves the device before the graph runs. The base context holds move, look, aim, and interact. Project JOHNO pushes a second context, the L2 modifier layer, while the left trigger is held. A face button that reloads on the base layer can open a radial slot on the modifier layer. The radial menu sends IA_Equip and a slot value. It does not line-trace to discover the stick. The stick is an axis. The sector is math on that axis.
layer.whyGame: In a real game, getting the modifier layer wrong shows up as setting Aiming from Tick, or firing the weapon from the camera graph. the aim action is the repair, and the generated line `Aiming = true; // node:tpl_camera_set` is that repair in C++.

expansions.title: The modifier layer as a door
expansions.detail: If the modifier layer is a use, the hit calls one interface. A door, a switch, and a pickup can share it without a new cast.

expansions.title: The modifier layer as data
expansions.detail: Designer numbers for the modifier layer live on a row. Aiming set true when the aim trace from the camera hits reads the row instead of a literal.

expansions.title: The modifier layer as a listener
expansions.detail: Later systems listen for IA_Aim. They do not setting Aiming from Tick, or firing the weapon from the camera graph.
